metric.name: IR-LIKENESS-1.0
metric.formula: On the common 4000→500 cm^-1 grid at 5 cm^-1 spacing: RMSE_T = sqrt(mean((T_generated-T_gold)^2)); r = Pearson(T_generated,T_gold); F1 = peak-matching F1 within ±40 cm^-1. Score = 40*(1-min(RMSE_T/50,1)) + 30*max(r,0) + 30*F1. Provisional pass requires score >= 55 AND RMSE_T < 25.
metric.notes: Likeness of exam envelopes, not pixel identity. The displayed row scores agree with the formula within rounding. Certification is withheld: n=10 but only nine items are supplied; peak extraction and matching are incompletely specified; axis calibration cannot be audited from scores; and the proposed pass threshold has not been independently validated. The scoring grid excludes 500–400 cm^-1 even though the generator covers it.

what_the_scores_mean: For the nine listed pairs, mean score is 30.48 old versus 31.12 IRSP: only +0.64 points, not evidence of a substantial overall improvement. The reported means 27.4 and 28.0 cannot be reproduced without the tenth record and aggregation policy. Under the provisional gate, old passes 1/9 and IRSP passes 0/9. The best listed pair regresses from 63.9 to 54.2; acids remain severe failures. 'ok: true' must not be interpreted as likeness acceptance.
ftir_csv_role: do_not_use_as_9701_gold. Exclude the food/ATR traces from exam-envelope fitting and certification. The ethanol absorbance column covers only 899–1802 cm^-1; at most use it for qualitative within-window band checks after verifying provenance, units and measurement conditions. Do not infer missing O-H/C-H regions. Even a justified conversion T=100*10^(-A) gives reference-dependent relative transmission, not a complete transmission-mode 9701 exam spectrum.

rulebook_updates.rule: Keep IR-LIKENESS-1.0 provisional until the evaluation manifest reconciles declared, supplied, evaluable and failed counts. Report invalid cases separately; never silently divide nine scores by ten or treat missing records as zero. Separate evaluation success from likeness_pass.
rulebook_updates.why: The nine listed old scores sum to 274.3 and IRSP scores to 280.1, yielding means 30.48 and 31.12. The supplied n and means therefore require clarification in the evaluation record.

rulebook_updates.rule: Calibrate each gold plot from its own tick anchors, including any nonuniform horizontal scale. Verify descending wavenumber, upward-increasing %T, trace selection and actual vertical units before tuning. Interpolate calibrated gold and generated traces onto the same 701-point grid without target-dependent shifts, warps, amplitude normalization or extrapolation. Insufficient coverage or calibration makes a case non-evaluable pending repair.
rulebook_updates.why: 9701_s20_qp_11:q29 has IRSP RMSE_T 43.97 and r=-0.238; 9701_s20_qp_13:q25 has RMSE_T 48.32 and r=-0.501. These justify an axis/trace audit but do not prove an axis inversion.

rulebook_updates.rule: Freeze peak smoothing, prominence, minimum separation, endpoint handling and empty-set conventions before rescoring. Express widths and separation in cm^-1 and prominence in %T. Match minima one-to-one, maximizing match count within ±40 cm^-1 with deterministic tie-breaking. Define handling of undefined Pearson correlation. Publish every regional window; distinguish carbonyl C=O from C-O and do not add overlapping regional RMSEs.
rulebook_updates.why: 9701_s18_qp_11:q30 loses F1 from 0.500 to 0.250. Conversely, 9701_w19_qp_13:q30 gains score while RMSE worsens from 27.73 to 29.00 and r falls from 0.655 to 0.560, because F1 rises from 0 to 0.308. Peak handling materially controls the verdict.

rulebook_updates.rule: Retain IRSP-2.5's 4 cm^-1 sampling and deterministic FGR shapes A/B/C/E, with seeded Lorentzian fingerprint structure and chemistry-gated diagnostic C-O. Define deterministic zone ownership and a continuous blend near 1500 cm^-1. Generate bounded 0–100 %T without discontinuities or clipping plateaus. Replace the universal flat 92% baseline only with a low-dimensional, shared baseline model justified by calibrated training envelopes.
rulebook_updates.why: 9701_m23_qp_12:q38 has FGR RMSE 13.43 but FPR 31.37; 9701_w19_qp_13:q30 has FGR 20.20 but FPR 43.80. Zone-specific correction is warranted, not an indiscriminate increase in spectral complexity.

rulebook_updates.rule: After calibration passes, fit a shared acid-family envelope: broad, potentially asymmetric super-Gaussian O-H over approximately 2500–3300 cm^-1, embedded C-H structure, and a separate carbonyl near the chemically appropriate acid position. Tune center, width, depth and overlap using signed residuals; do not infer the direction of a correction from RMSE alone.
rulebook_updates.why: 9701_s20_qp_13:q25 has OH/CH/FGR RMSE 61.97/56.44/53.37. 9701_s20_qp_11:q29 has OH/CH/C=O RMSE 47.88/51.28/48.50. Fingerprint embellishment cannot repair these dominant functional-region errors.

rulebook_updates.rule: Tune alcohol Gaussian O-H and Lorentzian C-H widths, depths and overlap jointly, with shared parameters and limited chemistry-conditioned modifiers. Treat polyol overlap and saturation explicitly rather than scaling O-H depth linearly with hydroxyl count. Preserve the old propan-1-ol result as a regression benchmark, not a trace to copy.
rulebook_updates.why: 9701_s18_qp_11:q30 has OH RMSE 21.13 but CH 47.85 and regresses by 9.7 score points. 9701_w19_qp_11:q30 has FGR RMSE 36.07. Glycerol, 9701_w23_qp_11:q39, has OH/CH RMSE 27.65/39.90.

rulebook_updates.rule: Calibrate carbonyl center, width and depth by functional-group family before adding more fingerprint peaks. Require chemistry-gated presence and absence: alcohols must not gain spurious carbonyl bands. Inspect signed residuals to distinguish displacement, excessive width, depth error and baseline error.
rulebook_updates.why: The two acetone cases, 9701_m23_qp_12:q38 and 9701_s18_qp_12:q30, have C=O RMSE 28.66 and 34.30. Alcohol carbonyl-region errors are already small in 9701_w19_qp_13:q30 and 9701_w23_qp_11:q39: 1.43 and 0.58.

rulebook_updates.rule: Place diagnostic C-O bands from functional-group chemistry before adding bounded background jags. Control jag density, prominence and width so random structure cannot manufacture peak matches. Derive seeds from canonical molecular identity, generator version and a documented global seed; never from exam UID, and never select the best seed against a target.
rulebook_updates.why: 9701_w19_qp_13:q30 has C-O/FPR RMSE 50.95/43.80; 9701_w23_qp_11:q39 has 49.07/48.65. More jags alone would not establish better diagnostic-envelope fidelity.

rulebook_updates.rule: Fit a small, shared parameter set using training-only band and envelope summaries. Keep all traces of a molecule together when testing molecular generalization, and prevent paper/trace duplication across splits. Report paired score, RMSE, r, F1 and pass-rate changes by chemical family. Retain a separate chemical-correctness audit; the composite score alone is not a chemical validity certificate.
rulebook_updates.why: Acetone, propan-1-ol and propan-2-ol each occur in multiple listed exam items. Same-molecule envelopes differ substantially, and the nine-pair mean improvement of 0.64 points conceals alcohol and acid regressions.

executed_fit_2026-09-14.generator: SMILES → family → shared IRSP-2.5 parameters in irsp_fitted.json (no gold polyline lookup)
executed_fit_2026-09-14.note: Alcohols/ketones improved; acids still fail a shared envelope. 100% needs gold T(ν); SMILES-only ceiling is the LOO RMSE above.

first_principles_2026-09-14.identity_floor: Re-rendering exam gold T(ν) through render_ir_from_curve yields score 94–100 on most overlap papers (s18_qp_11 = 100.0). Failure of chemistry-only IR is not TikZ syntax; it is the wrong T(ν).
first_principles_2026-09-14.problem: Recover the exam drawing T(ν), not invent chemistry from SMILES alone.

next_finetune: 1. Recover the missing evaluation record, reconcile denominators, and audit gold tick calibration, %T direction and trace selection—starting with both acids. Recompute the existing generators before changing their parameters.

2. Freeze the complete metric implementation and regional windows. Validate the provisional threshold against independent human judgments of acceptable exam-envelope likeness and chemically wrong negative controls.
3. Tune shared acid O-H/C-H/carbonyl parameters on audited training data. Use signed residuals and low-dimensional envelope summaries, not pointwise polyline memorization.
4. Repair alcohol O-H/C-H overlap and acetone carbonyl morphology. Use the old 9701_s18_qp_11:q30 result as a regression check while requiring improvements across other training examples.

5. Tune chemistry-conditioned C-O and fingerprint envelope statistics, then jag density and prominence. Fix seeds in advance and assess seed sensitivity separately; do not maximize score by seed search.

6. Run grouped held-out comparisons against both old and unchanged IRSP-2.5. Report every case, failures, paired deltas, family results and uncertainty. Promote the revision only for reproducible gains without concealed chemical or regional regressions.
